biography.text: Accomplished musician, David Andrew has already worked with the likes of Tones and I, and Gang of Youths, played in stadiums around the world with Hillsong United. He started his solo recording career after responding to his mother’s request for a Piano album of Hymns, this unlikely success has David now turning his eye to taking familiar pop tunes and rearranging them in a style that is both creative and functional, and will help people find peace.
